about: Three generation attempts of the leaderboard's runs ended outside the six outcome categories. Each leaves the Pass@1 denominator of its cell. scripts/build_leaderboard.py applies them when it rebuilds the leaderboard from the recorded cells. A run of this harness classifies such attempts itself (infrastructure_excluded).

provenance.source: the attempt exclusions of the paper's tables

exclude_attempts.reason: passed_but_nonzero_exit (every step passed, Go process exited 1)
